title: Yak-52 R4 final-art production plan from preserved L88 and R3 evaluation evidence
purpose: Define the next isolated Blender production source and later Unreal acceptance package needed to close the visibly blockout-grade Yak-52 gap. This is an offline planning contract only. It does not launch Blender or Unreal, alter accepted assets, import, promote donors, replace the runtime aircraft, or claim final, AAA, production-ready, or shipping acceptance.

immutability_policy.change_method: Create a new versioned contract and immutable verification attempt; never silently revise accepted R3 evidence or R4 requirements.

authority_inputs.role: R3 final-art rejection and evaluation-only boundary
Rejected whole-aircraft donor study and bounded donor direction
Automated donor compatibility evidence and human-promotion boundary
Exact ten-mesh quarantine donor set, datums, and safety volumes
R3 coordinate system, source inheritance, cameras, and component accounting
R3 object inventory, matched images, donor identities, and explicit non-final claims
Fresh Unreal quarantine persistence and compatibility evidence
Current runtime bundle and component baseline

current_blender_source_inventory.allowed_use: Byte-copy into a new isolated R4 namespace; never save over this source.
Construction-study reference only; no whole-aircraft reuse.
Only the ten already reconstructed and quarantined R3 donor components and four reference datums may be evaluated.
Inventory and comparison reference; do not overwrite and do not treat inherited components as final.
Existing donor compatibility evidence only; never use as R4 whole-aircraft import.
Reuse generic utilities and matched-camera values only after rebinding all R4 identifiers and paths.

visible_final_art_rejections: Wing, tail, fuselage, and canopy silhouettes remain visibly blockout-grade and not reference-faithful Yak-52 production surfaces.
Crew anatomy, hands, gloves, sleeves, and weapon grips remain simplified and need rigged production replacements.
Rifle and Igla geometry, sights, controls, and material response remain insufficient for first-person hero use.
Cockpit lacks production instruments, trim, harness, padding, fasteners, labels, wiring, and wear.
Exterior lacks calibrated paint, bare metal, glass, rubber, weathering, livery, panels, seams, and rivets.
No final component set has passed scale, sockets, collision, ADS, pilot safety, Igla launch axis, animation, LOD, material, or packaged performance validation.

automated_evidence_proves: Bounds origins match governed pivot datums.
Every mesh has at least one material slot and simple collision.
Donor bounds do not intersect camera, pilot, rifle, or Igla safety volumes.
Rear-gunner physical sightline remains level and unobstructed.
automated_evidence_does_not_prove: ADS, firing, launch, backblast, or pilot-safety gameplay behavior.
Runtime frame time, memory, draw calls, LOD transitions, or packaged persistence.

coordinate_and_scale_contract.aircraft_origin: Defined aircraft reference datum retained from L88 runtime contract
coordinate_and_scale_contract.transform_application: Production render meshes must export with scale 1,1,1 and documented pivots; armature and animation transforms must remain intentional.
coordinate_and_scale_contract.dimension_acceptance: Reference-board dimensions, station drawings, and photo-derived proportions must be recorded with confidence and source provenance before silhouette approval.
coordinate_and_scale_contract.symmetry_policy: Primary airframe may use controlled symmetry during construction; asymmetrical panels, wear, placards, antennas, controls, and crew staging must be authored explicitly.

ordered_asset_slices.name: Reference board, dimensions, and silhouette lock
scope: Create a dimensioned Yak-52 reference board with source provenance and confidence labels.
Lock fuselage stations, cowling diameter, cockpit openings, canopy profile, wing planform, dihedral, tail planform, gear stance, and propeller disc.
Build clean low-detail primary volumes in an isolated R4 source without surface microdetail.
required_outputs: R4 reference index and dimension ledger
Matched side, top, front three-quarter, rear three-quarter, and underside renders
ordered_asset_slices.exit_gate: Human silhouette approval against dimensioned references; no later slice may compensate for an inaccurate primary shape.

ordered_asset_slices.name: Production exterior surfaces and control breaks
scope: Rebuild fuselage, wings, wing-root fairings, leading edges, horizontal tail, vertical tail, rudder, elevator, ailerons, and flaps as reference-faithful surfaces.
Author real panel boundaries, access panels, hinges, control gaps, vent openings, exhaust interfaces, antennas, and navigation-light housings.
Preserve removable or animated parts as logical production groups with documented pivots.
required_outputs: Production exterior high and game meshes
ordered_asset_slices.exit_gate: No blockout facets, generic planform, broken shading, nonphysical panel thickness, or silhouette regression at any acceptance camera.

ordered_asset_slices.name: Cowling, radial face, propeller, and landing-gear integration
scope: Evaluate the ten R3 donors individually against the locked R4 silhouette and reference board.
Rebuild or refine cowling shell, front ring, shutters, inlet cone, spinner, two-blade propeller, wheel wells, struts, forks, hubs, tires, brakes, doors, and fairings.
Create a single documented propeller axis and separate static-blade, motion-disc, and stopped-state presentation groups.
Reject any donor that fits mechanically but remains visually generic or under-detailed.
required_outputs: Per-donor accept-rebuild-reject record with matched images
Propeller blade profile, pitch, hub, spinner, axis, and motion-state ledger
Gear pivot, wheel contact, well clearance, and retraction-volume ledger
ordered_asset_slices.exit_gate: Human donor promotion per component plus reference-faithful propeller and gear appearance; compatibility evidence alone is insufficient.

ordered_asset_slices.name: Front canopy and opening rear-gunner canopy system
scope: Rebuild front and rear canopy glazing, bows, rails, rollers, seals, hinges, latches, handles, cockpit rims, and fairings with correct alignment and thickness.
Keep the pilot enclosed and protected while the rear canopy can slide to the documented open firing position.
Document rear-canopy closed, transit, open, and stowed transforms without intersecting crew, rifle, Igla, camera, or airframe.
Provide glass interior/exterior surfaces, edge treatment, frame masking, dirt breakup, and non-occluding optical response.
required_outputs: Glass thickness, normals, UV, and material-interface audit
ordered_asset_slices.exit_gate: No cube-like glazing, misaligned bows, missing rear frame, camera occlusion, pilot exposure, weapon intersection, or implausible glass response.

ordered_asset_slices.name: Front and rear cockpit production interiors
scope: Rebuild cockpit tub, front and rear panels, gauges, bezels, needles, glass, warning lamps, placards, switches, guards, throttle quadrants, trim, sticks, pedals, radios, map light, wiring, padding, seats, harnesses, fasteners, and wear.
Prioritize rear-gunner eye visibility and physical instrument depth while retaining pilot legibility from rear-seat views.
Use decals or texture detail for sub-pixel fasteners and labels instead of excessive component meshes.
required_outputs: Cockpit production high and game meshes
ordered_asset_slices.exit_gate: Rear cockpit reads as a real aircraft interior at first-person distance with no box-driven gaps, floating controls, unreadable hierarchy, or camera obstruction.

ordered_asset_slices.name: Rigged pilot and rear-gunner crew
scope: Replace simplified pilot and gunner bodies with anatomically credible, clothed, rigged production characters.
Author pilot head, helmet/headset, torso, arms, gloves, legs, harness contact, control grip, and seated posture.
Author distinct first-person rear-gunner arms/hands/gloves/sleeves and a third-person seated body with compatible proportions.
Prevent block limbs, fused fingers, collapsed glove silhouettes, floating elbows, cloth intersections, and weapon-grip mismatch.
required_outputs: Rear-gunner third-person skeletal mesh and rig
Skinning, pose, harness-contact, and cockpit-clearance audits
ordered_asset_slices.exit_gate: Hands, arms, posture, cockpit contact, and weapon grips remain credible through aim, recoil, reload, Igla shoulder, canopy motion, and pilot-control poses.

ordered_asset_slices.name: First-person rifle and Igla interaction set
scope: Rebuild rifle receiver, barrel, muzzle, gas system, handguard, magazine, stock, trigger, guard, safety, sights, apertures, sling hardware, and contact surfaces for first-person hero use.
Rebuild Igla tube, caps, battery, grip, trigger, sight, shoulder rest, launch axis, missile axis, and backblast datum.
Align rifle front/rear sights to the physical ADS camera and preserve left-click firing while right-click ADS is held.
Align hand placement, trigger discipline, recoil axis, muzzle sweep, missile launch direction, and backblast clearance.
required_outputs: ADS alignment and hand-contact pose set
Pilot no-fire and Igla backblast clearance evidence plan
ordered_asset_slices.exit_gate: No artificial reticle is required for alignment; sights, hands, weapon axes, pilot blocker, canopy opening, and firing clearance are physically coherent.

ordered_asset_slices.name: UV, bake, calibrated PBR, livery, and weathering
scope: Create non-overlapping game UVs, intentional mirrored regions, bake cages, material IDs, and traceable high-to-low normal, AO, curvature, thickness, and position bakes.
Build calibrated paint, bare metal, canopy glass, rubber, engine metal, cockpit paint, instrument, gauge glass/emissive, leather, fabric, skin, rifle, Igla, decal, and grime material families.
Apply livery, stencils, placards, panel seams, rivet rows, fasteners, paint wear, oil, exhaust, salt, dust, fingerprints, and localized wetness at physically plausible scale.
Use geometry only for silhouette, parallax-critical, animated, or collision-relevant detail; use trim sheets, decals, and normals for repeated microdetail.
required_outputs: Bake manifest with source and derivative hashes
Daylight, overcast, night, wet, and storm material review renders
ordered_asset_slices.exit_gate: No flat color, uniform roughness, incorrect metalness, painted-on glass, repeating grime, oversized rivets, unreadable labels, or lighting-dependent material failure.

ordered_asset_slices.name: Production grouping, pivots, sockets, rigs, and collision
scope: Consolidate the 240 governed source identities into bounded render groups without losing traceable component metadata.
Finalize canopy, propeller, control-surface, landing-gear, crew, and weapon pivots plus named gameplay sockets.
Author simple collision, ground-contact bodies, pilot/cockpit shot blockers, canopy interaction, camera clearance, rifle sweep, launch axis, and backblast volumes.
Keep cosmetic microdetail out of gameplay collision and forbid complex-as-simple collision for the aircraft.
required_outputs: Animation range and deformation test plan
ordered_asset_slices.exit_gate: All gameplay interfaces are deterministic, collision is simple and bounded, cosmetic components cannot block fire, and no required motion changes scale or origin.

ordered_asset_slices.name: Isolated export, matched visual review, and Unreal performance acceptance package
scope: Save and export only to the isolated R4 namespace with an immutable source/export manifest.
Render every fixed acceptance camera under governed lighting and color management.
Import only into a new Unreal quarantine path after a separate authorization.
Measure scale, materials, sockets, collisions, ADS, pilot safety, canopy motion, propeller states, crew animation, Igla axes, LODs, draw calls, memory, frame time, and packaged persistence.
Require explicit human visual and runtime promotion approval before any current aircraft replacement.
required_outputs: Immutable R4 Blender source and export hashes
Fresh Unreal quarantine import and persistence audit
Performance capture at the fixed target profile
Human visual and technical review receipt
ordered_asset_slices.exit_gate: Only a complete hash-bound visual, gameplay, persistence, and performance package may be considered for later human runtime promotion.

visual_acceptance_contract.color_management: Fixed neutral transform and exposure recorded in the R4 manifest; identical across matched candidates.
visual_acceptance_contract.lighting_rig: Governed neutral key-fill-rim plus fixed world; additional daylight, overcast, night, wet, and storm material rigs may not replace neutral matched views.
required_manual_review_dimensions: Crew anatomy, pose, hand and glove quality
No regression against preserved L88 scope

material_and_texture_contract.runtime_texture_format: Lossless authored masters; Unreal platform compression selected during governed import.
pbr_rules: Metalness represents material class and is not used as a generic brightness control.
Roughness contains calibrated macro and micro variation without uniform procedural noise.
Normal intensity remains physically plausible and cannot replace silhouette detail.
Glass has modeled thickness, correct normals, bounded refraction, dirt breakup, and cockpit-readable transmission.
Weathering follows airflow, maintenance access, exhaust, oil, foot, hand, salt, and rain exposure.
Repeated rivets and fasteners use trim, decal, or normal workflows unless silhouette or animation requires geometry.
No baked scene lighting, view-dependent highlight, or destructive color grading is stored in base color.

required_pose_tests: Rear gunner rifle recoil and reload
Rear gunner Igla shoulder, launch, and stow
required_quality_checks: Individual finger and thumb silhouette at first-person distance
No block arms or glove mitts
No elbow, wrist, shoulder, thigh, harness, canopy, or cockpit penetration
Stable wrist and finger deformation through aim and recoil
Third-person and first-person hand placement agree at shared weapon sockets

axis_rules: Rifle projectile origin and direction use SOCKET_RifleMuzzle and SOCKET_RifleSightAxis.
Igla missile exits SOCKET_IglaLaunch along the documented forward axis; backblast extends from SOCKET_IglaBackblast in the opposite direction.
Propeller rotation is constant mission-speed presentation around PIVOT_Propeller without alternating slowdown or reverse aliasing.
Rear canopy motion uses PIVOT_RearCanopy and the documented travel path without changing aircraft origin or scale.

collision_groups.role: broad wing, tail, and control-surface envelope
opening canopy interaction and obstruction checks
camera, pilot no-fire, cockpit blocker, rifle sweep, Igla launch, and backblast

trace_rules: Pilot and forward cockpit blockers prevent weapon traces through the pilot.
Cosmetic canopy glass may not become the sole pilot-safety blocker.
Weapon traces ignore cosmetic rivets, labels, controls, harnesses, and microdetail.
Propeller motion-disc geometry has no gameplay collision.
Canopy, crew, rifle, and Igla swept-volume tests must pass through required animations.

target_profile.platform: Windows desktop target hardware to be fixed in the R4 Unreal gate
target_profile.measurement_scene: Isolated Yak plus representative Mission 1 coast, combat VFX disabled for art-cost capture and enabled for combined soak

lod_requirements: At least four reviewed render LOD states or an explicitly accepted equivalent for non-skeletal aircraft groups.
No visible silhouette pop at governed screen-size transitions.
Cockpit, first-person arms, and held weapon remain highest fidelity only when visible from the rear-gunner camera.
Distant aircraft removes cockpit microdetail, crew fingers, labels, fastener geometry, and transparent-layer cost before silhouette loss.
Propeller uses governed stopped/static-blade, fast-motion-disc, and distance states without frame-rate-dependent speed modulation.
failure_rules: No budget may be waived because the game will be downloadable rather than streamed.
Median and worst one-percent frame time, not average FPS alone, must pass.
ADS plus firing, canopy open, rifle impact, Igla launch, and drone-destruction soak must not introduce multi-second stalls.
Shader compilation, asset warm-up, and first-use hitch evidence must be recorded separately from steady-state frame time.
Any budget exception requires a new versioned contract, measured justification, and explicit approval.

required_future_evidence: All ten asset slices completed in order with immutable receipts.
Complete Blender source, export, texture, bake, and edit-chain hashes.
All thirteen governed acceptance-camera renders with manual review.
Fresh Unreal quarantine import and persistence audit.
Scale, material, socket, pivot, collision, ADS, pilot-safety, canopy, propeller, crew, rifle, and Igla functional evidence.
LOD, draw-call, triangle, texture-memory, CPU, render-thread, GPU, hitch, and packaged-soak evidence.
Explicit visual, gameplay, technical-art, and performance reviewer approvals.
Separate explicit authorization before runtime replacement.
